cong_thuc.ten: MIN loai thang nghi (=0) bang mang: MIN(IF)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Thang nghi doanh thu =0 lam MIN(0) sai; IF>0 loc lay so duong roi MIN. CSE cho Excel cu; 365 dung MINIFS gon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doanh thu T1-T12 co 0 thang nghi: =MIN(IF(B2:B13>0,B2:B13)) + CSE ra min that (vd 15) thay vi 0.

cong_thuc.ten: Chuan bi Table dong (Ctrl+T) lam nguon Dashboard
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong ~5000 dong khi them thang moi; moi Pivot lay ten Table lam nguon nen Refresh la nap, khong sua Source.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Vung A1:F5000 thanh Table Du lieu; them thang 13 vao dong cuoi tu nam vao Table.

cong_thuc.ten: Tao Pivot tu Table + keo Nam/Thang > Rows, Doanh thu > Values
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Moi Pivot 1 sheet rieng cho gon; Rows liet ke thoi gian, Values tong tien. Sau dinh dang Tabular, tat Subtotal/Grand thua.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pivot1: Rows=Nam/Thang, Values=Sum Doanh thu theo thang de ve Line theo thoi gian.

cong_thuc.ten: Report Layout Tabular + tat Grand/Subtotal thua
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tabular tach moi field 1 cot ro hon Compact; tat tong thua cho chart Top/Bottom gon, chi giu tong khi can.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pivot Top SP: Tabular + Grand Off de chi thay Top 3 sach.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot nen loc/slicer tu nhay. Column so sanh, Line xu huong, Pie ty trong. Copy chart cu doi kieu nhanh hon ve moi.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart Column doanh thu theo thang; copy sang lam Pie % Khu vuc bang Change Type.

cong_thuc.ten: Nhan ban PivotChart: Ctrl keo sheet + Ctrl keo chart
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhan sheet de co pivot+chart moi doc lap; nhan chart trong cung sheet de doi truong Legend/Axis thanh chart moi (Khu vuc -> NPP).
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ctrl-keo sheet chart Top 3 thanh sheet Bottom 3 roi doi Top sang Bottom. Ctrl-keo chart Khu vuc thanh chart NPP.

cong_thuc.ten: Top 3 / Bottom 3 bang Value Filter Top 10
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Loc theo gia tri tong chu khong phai ten. Doi 10 thanh 3; Bottom cho 3 SP te nhat. Ket hop sort giam dan + reverse axis cho Top 1 len tren.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Row=San pham > Top 3 by Sum Doanh thu -> SP07, SP03, SP01 cao nhat. Doi Bottom 3 -> 3 SP thap nhat.

cong_thuc.ten: Dao truc cho Top 1 len tren (Reverse)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chart cot ngang sort lon->be nhung Top 1 lai nam duoi; reverse dua Top 1 len tren cung de doc tu tren xuong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Top 3 sort giam dan nhung SP1 o duoi > Reverse -> SP1 len tren.

cong_thuc.ten: Data Labels: Add + Category Name + Value + #,##0 + %
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Cot hien so tien; Pie hien ten mien + tien (+%). #,##0 tach nghin (333333->333,333). Vi tri Outside End/Auto cho khoi de.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Pie Khu vuc: tick Name+Value -> 'Mien Nam 40% 1,234,567'. Column: Outside End + #,##0.

cong_thuc.ten: Trang tri Series: Border + Smooth line
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Vien cot tron dep, day 2-3pt mau thuong hieu; Smooth lam line cong mem thay vi goc canh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Cot vien cam 3pt; Line doanh thu tick Smooth de mem.

cong_thuc.ten: Chart Title + Legend + resize bo cuc Dashboard
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Title ro muc dich tung chart; Legend chu thich mau; resize can doi de 4-5 chart vua 1 man hinh khong cuon.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Title 'Doanh thu Top 3 SP', Legend Bottom, resize 4 chart vua sheet Dashboard.

cong_thuc.ten: Doi truong chart: Khu vuc -> Nha phan phoi
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tan dung chart cu doi chieu phan tich ma khong ve moi: thay field Legend/Axis giu nguyen kieu Pie/Column.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tu Pie % Khu vuc: bo Khu vuc, keo NPP vao -> Pie % NPP (FPT 30%...).

cong_thuc.giai_thich: 4 slicer dieu khien toan dashboard: Nam/Thang thoi gian, Khu vuc/NPP khong gian kenh. Copy slicer cu dung lai nhanh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 4 slicer tren dau Dashboard: Nam (2019/2020), Thang (1-12), Khu vuc, NPP.

cong_thuc.ten: Report Connections: 1 slicer dieu khien all chart
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Buoc song con cua dashboard: noi moi slicer toi moi pivot/chart. Thieu 1 tick la chart do dung yen khi loc -> lech. Test 2020 xem all nhay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nam tick Pivot1..Pivot5; bam 2020 ca 5 chart deu doi theo 2020.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Multi chon nhieu nam/thang de so sanh; Clear tra ve all de test dong bo sau moi lan loc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bat Multi chon 2019+2020 so sanh; Clear de ve trang thai all truoc khi gui sep.

cong_thuc.ten: Refresh + an sheet phu + test + luu file song
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table mo rong + Refresh nap thang moi. Hide sheet trung gian chi giu Dashboard sach. Gui file song de sep tu bam slicer, khong gui anh chet/PDF tinh.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them T13 > Refresh All > test Nam 2020, Thang 3, Khu vuc Nam -> all chart nhay dung > Hide sheets phu > luu Dashboard.xlsx gui.

quiz.cau: Vi sao phai doi vung thanh Table truoc dashboard?
quiz.A: De tu mo rong khi them dong, Pivot tu cap nhat
quiz.giai_thich: Table nap dong moi vao Pivot qua Refresh.

quiz.cau: Phim tat tao Table la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ctrl+T mo Create Table.

quiz.cau: Khi tao Table can tick gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Bao dong dau la tieu de.

quiz.cau: Pivot tao tu nguon nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Dat ten Table roi lay lam Source dong.

quiz.cau: Nen dat Pivot moi o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Sheet rieng gon, sau copy ve Dashboard.

quiz.cau: Keo Nam/Thang vao dau? Doanh thu vao dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Rows liet ke, Values tinh tong.

quiz.cau: Tabular Form de lam gi?
quiz.C: Hien dang bang tach cot ro
quiz.giai_thich: Ro hon Compact khi nhieu cap.

quiz.cau: Grand/Subtotal thua thi lam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Gon chart Top/Bottom.

quiz.cau: Ve bieu do tu Pivot dung lenh nao?
quiz.giai_thich: PivotChart gan pivot, nhay theo loc.

quiz.cau: Nhan ban sheet chart nhanh bang gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Nhan ban de lam chart bien the.

quiz.cau: Nhan ban chart trong cung sheet bang gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ctrl+drag copy chart roi doi field.

quiz.cau: Loc Top 3 SP cao nhat dung gi?
quiz.D: Row Labels > Value Filter > Top 10 doi 10 thanh 3
quiz.giai_thich: Top theo Sum Doanh thu.

quiz.cau: Xem 3 SP te nhat thi chon gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Bottom cho thap nhat.

quiz.cau: Top 1 lai nam duoi cung sau sort thi sua sao?
quiz.B: Format Axis > Categories in reverse order
quiz.giai_thich: Dao truc dua lon len tren.

quiz.cau: Hien so tien tren cot dung gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Right-click series > Add.

quiz.cau: Pie muon hien ca ten mien + tien thi tick gi?
quiz.D: Format Data Labels > Category Name + Value
quiz.giai_thich: Tick ca ten + gia tri.

quiz.cau: 333333 thanh 333,333 thi format gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Custom tach nghin.

quiz.cau: Them % canh so tien tren Pie thi tick gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Tick Percentage them ty trong.

quiz.cau: Line goc canh muon mem thi tick gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Format Series > Smooth.

quiz.cau: Vien cot cam day 3pt chinh o dau?
quiz.D: Format Data Series > Border Solid line Width 3pt
quiz.giai_thich: Chon mau + do rong vien.

quiz.cau: Ten Top 3, Bottom 3 dat o dau?
quiz.A: Chart Title (sua thanh Doanh thu Top 3...)
quiz.giai_thich: Title ro muc dich chart.

quiz.cau: Them chu thich mau bang gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Tick Legend keo vi tri hop.

quiz.cau: Tu Pie Khu vuc muon thanh Pie NPP thi lam gi?
quiz.C: Bo Khu vuc khoi Legend, keo NPP vao (PivotChart Fields)
quiz.giai_thich: Doi truong Legend/Axis.

quiz.cau: Chart qua to/nho thi lam gi?
quiz.D: Keo goc resize cho vua bo cuc Dashboard
quiz.giai_thich: Snap 2x2/3x2 can doi.

quiz.cau: Slicer de lam gi?
quiz.A: Nut loc truc quan Nam/Thang/Khu vuc/NPP
quiz.giai_thich: Bam loc dong loat.

quiz.cau: Chen Slicer bang cach nao?
quiz.B: Chon Pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer (chon 4 truong)
quiz.giai_thich: 4 truong Nam/Thang/Khu vuc/NPP.

quiz.cau: Lam sao 1 Slicer loc TAT CA chart?
quiz.C: Right-click Slicer > Report Connections > tick het pivot
quiz.giai_thich: Noi slicer toi moi PivotTable.

quiz.cau: Quen tick 1 pivot trong Connections thi sao?
quiz.D: Chart do dung yen, lech so lieu
quiz.giai_thich: Phai tick het de dong bo.

quiz.cau: Bam 2020 ma 1 chart khong doi thi kiem tra gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Chart chua noi slicer.

quiz.cau: Bam nam 2020 thi thao tac nao dung?
quiz.giai_thich: Slicer loc 1 gia tri.

quiz.cau: Chon nhieu nam/thang de so sanh thi dung gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Tick nhieu muc.

quiz.cau: Xoa loc slicer de ve all thi bam gi?
quiz.D: Clear Filter (bieu tuong loc X) tren slicer
quiz.giai_thich: Clear tra ve all de test.

quiz.cau: An sheet phu chi giu Dashboard bang gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Shift chon roi Hide cho sach.

quiz.cau: Them thang moi vao Table roi pivot chua thay thi lam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Table mo rong, Refresh nap.

quiz.cau: Cong thuc MIN loai thang nghi 0 la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Loc >0 roi MIN, bo qua 0 nghi.

quiz.cau: Nguon ~5000 dong thi luu y gi?
quiz.D: Dung Table+Pivot tu dong, tranh cong thuc mang nang
quiz.giai_thich: Pivot xu ly nghin dong nhanh.

quiz.cau: Muc dich cuoi dashboard la gi?
quiz.A: Theo doi doanh thu nam/thang, top/bottom SP, ty trong vung/NPP 1 man hinh
quiz.giai_thich: Mot man hinh thay moi goc kinh doanh.

quiz.cau: Hoan thien gui sep can test gi cuoi?
quiz.B: Bam tung slicer xem all chart nhay dung + Refresh + Hide sheet phu roi luu
quiz.giai_thich: Kiem tra dong bo roi gui file song.

quiz.cau: Gui dashboard cho sep nen gui dang nao?
quiz.C: Excel XLSX giu Pivot+Slicer song de sep tu loc
quiz.giai_thich: Giu tuong tac, khong gui anh chet/PDF tinh.

quiz.cau: Keo chart che mat slicer thi xu ly the nao?
quiz.D: Resize + keo chart/slicer lai cho khong de, snap bo cuc
quiz.giai_thich: Bo cuc thoang moi bam duoc.
